_comment: Frozen contract for @-mentions in message text. Two forms:
@handle   a mention: the handle is an L9 recipient, its herdr doorbell
rings once it is idle, and an engine handle is summoned.
@~handle  a silent mention: it names the handle (drawn as a member, found
by mentions:handle) and never wakes, addresses or summons it.
A token counts only at the start of the text or after whitespace, ( or <,
so an email address is neither. The backend (fastapi-backend/app/services/
persister.py: parse_mentions, parse_silent_mentions) and the frontend
(mycelium-frontend/src/lib/mentions.ts) each parse it; both assert every
